newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Alameda County Trans Auth, Calif..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Alameda County Trans Auth, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL BONDS
Subordinate Sales Tax Revenue Bonds (Limited Tax Bonds),
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Alameda County
Transportation Authority (the Authority'') intends to offer for public sale on

at the hour of 10:00 A.M. (Pacific Standard Time) at the office of Rauscher Pierce Refsnes, Inc., One Market Plaza, 1100 Steuart Street Tower, San Francisco, California 94105, $90,000,000* principal amount of sales tax revenue bonds of the Authority designated
Authority Subordinated Sales Tax Revenue Bonds (Limited Tax Bonds), Series 1997,'' dated January 1, 1997 (the
Bonds''). If an acceptable bid is not received on January 14, 1997, bids will be received every Tuesday thereafter until the earlier of the first Tuesday when a bid is accepted or February 25, 1997.

The sale date on January 14, 1997 may be postponed upon no less than 24 hours notice given prior to the times bids are to be received by the Executive Director of the Authority, communicated through Munifacts News Service or Bloomberg's Financial News Wire. If such a postponement occurs, the sale will occur on the next succeeding Tuesday, at the hour and place stated above, or such other time and place as the Executive Director shall determine.

NOTICE IS HEREBY FURTHER GIVEN that the Bonds will be offered for public sale subject to the terms and conditions of the Notice Inviting Bids for the Bonds. An Official Statement relating to the Bonds will be furnished upon request to Rauscher Pierce Refsnes, Inc., One Market Plaza, 1100 Steuart Street Tower, San Francisco, California 94105, (415) 979-0300 or Grigsby & Associates, Inc., 101 California Street, Suite 2000, San Francisco, California 94111, (415) 392-4800, Co-Financial Advisors to the Authority in
connection with the sale of the Bonds.
